# Image Register

Every image on the site, with its source and rights. Rule: no image may imply it shows Al Qasim Movers' own work unless it does.

**Source of all current images:** supplied by the business owner on 2026-09-20, in `design-reference/`. The originals (13 MB total) are kept there; the site ships resized AVIF + WebP versions generated by `scratchpad/process_images.py`.

## Logo
| File | Use | Sizes shipped |
|---|---|---|
| `logo/al-qasim-movers-logo-{240,360,600}.{png,webp}` | Header and footer | 240 / 360 / 600 px wide |
| `logo/mark-512.png`, `logo/mark-32.png` | Favicon, app icon, schema `image` | 512, 32 px |
| `logo/apple-touch-icon.png` | iOS home screen (opaque white background) | 180 px |

The logo artwork also confirmed the legal name: **Al Qasim Movers L.L.C** (now in `config/business.json`).

## Compression results
13.0 MB of originals → **1.5 MB** across every size and format. Largest single file shipped: 101 KB (hero at 1920 px). A visitor downloads far less, because the browser picks one size in one format.

## Rules for new images
- Descriptive, lowercase, hyphenated file names — never `IMG_1234.jpg`.
- Always AVIF + WebP, at least two widths, with `width`/`height` set in the HTML.
- Lazy-load everything except the hero image (which carries `fetchpriority="high"`).
- Add a row here, with the source and who holds the rights.
- If a stock photo is ever used, it must not be captioned or positioned as Al Qasim Movers' own job.
